chunks: (What) you worship besides Him are nothing but names that you and your fathers have assigned, for which no sanction has been sent down by God. Authority belongs to God alone. He commands that you worship none but Him. This is the right way; but most men are ignorant.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the idols worshipped by polytheists in Surah Yusuf?
ai.summary: In the context of Prophet Yusuf’s discourse with his fellow prisoners, this verse critiques the anthropogenic origin of idolatry, emphasizing that polytheists follow mere names without divine *sultan* (proof or authority). It establishes *Al-Hukm* (judgment/authority) as exclusively divine, defining the *Deen al-Qayyim* (upright religion) as pure monotheism, a concept central to Shia theology regarding the legitimacy of divine command over human innovation. The verse concludes by noting that the majority's ignorance stems from a failure to recognize this singular authority.
